title: XXXIII Dias Formation
description: Multiple warplane silhouettes drawn in black ink are layered across a white ground alongside four compact discs, gold tape stripes, and a red-and-black bullseye collage element. Iridescent ribbon strips, star cutouts, and small circular targets animate the lower register; handwritten text reads 'XXXIII dias' at bottom.
composition: scattered warplanes and discs across white ground
